test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b7f33eb45836ca67903410f4978653b95121c5b1f8f13388dd994b0a8839b31.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The elements at the corner shift in a Z-shaped clockwise direction subsequently.

The rest of the element shift anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0327cd08dede755affaaae1b6681097297980ee18cc698d0a8f95c916a7548d.png] 

2) Second box series → 

The right diagonal elements shift anticlockwise in the upward direction.

The first two element of the left left diagonal elements interchange positions.

The last two element of the left left diagonal elements interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a46225c83a2401352df1bbb2f72f3326a5d1900468fdeb77ed43d92271c6c34.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcb183affccb1d4b2e2c440aae17720beea001469938256e6ddd828d809ca4c0.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
